title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
两个小时后。纽约时间凌晨四点三十分。位于曼哈顿下城区警察广场1号的NYPD总部特殊会议室里。不大的房间里坐着包括白宫幕僚长、纽约市市长、纽约警察局局长在内的一个又一个职位大得吓人的官员，气氛凝肃得可怕。“呼......”平时也算是个人物的乔治.詹特利，在这会议室里却是职位最低的，要不是这件案子正好是在他管辖的范围，他现在甚至没有资格出现在这里。“这是我们从布鲁克林高地物业那里调取的监控画面。”“从视频里可以看出来，卢克.邓肯无论是速度、力量还是防御力都远远超出了普通人类的范畴......”乔治.詹特利将一次性U盘插进了物理断网的设备中。U盘在拔出后就会销毁，而之后更会进行物理层面的粉碎，而这间屋中更是所有设备、手机都无法与外界联网。在会议室的幕布上，投影仪将影像投射出来，虽然没有声音，但并不影响整体的观看。只见在画面中，看起来体型还有些瘦弱的中年人，此刻却展现出了完全不属于人类的恐怖力量。只是轻轻一碰，钢筋水泥浇筑的墙壁就被他撞出了一个大窟窿。而后等到两名纽约警员赶到时，那些子弹也无法穿透他看似薄薄的一层皮肤。这种只在好莱坞电影里看到过的画面，让在场众人目不转睛，心跳不自觉地有些加快。今年六十一岁，已经成为华盛顿第二具有权力的人的白宫幕僚长威廉.戴利扭头看向乔治.詹特利，蔚蓝色的眼眸里仍然残留着一些不敢置信，又或者说，出于政客本能的怀疑。他声音有些低沉地道：“乔治警长，我想知道除了这个视频之外，还有其他能让我带回白宫的证据吗？”“当然。”经过了这样一会儿的适应，乔治.詹特利已经恢复了平时精明干练的模样。他一点不啰嗦地播放了第二段视频。这次出现在画面中的是一个光线有些昏暗的小巷。小巷平时脏乱的灰色水泥地面，此时已经被另外一种颜色所取代。刺目的红色映入在场所有人的眼帘。除此之外，还有五颜六色、在地面上缓缓流淌的内脏肠子以及断成两截的尸体。会议室内大部分人见此都不适地皱起了眉头。乔治.詹特利适时出声讲解道：“视频里的凶杀案发生在布鲁克林区第36号大街一侧的小巷子里。”“根据我们目前掌握的线索还有目击者的证词，基本上可以判断，这里才是卢克.邓肯首次出手杀人的场所。”“时间大概是纽约时间凌晨一点三十七分。”“那时候他刚从附近的快餐店出来，在前往纽约布鲁克林大桥的过程中，被几个黑人小混混拽进小巷子里。在此之前，卢克.邓肯并没有表现出任何的特殊之处，甚至，他还被其中一个黑人混混捅了几刀......”“所以，乔治警长你的意思是？！”在场众人哪个不是人精。听到这里一个个眼睛纷纷亮了起来。

“在接到报案，并且将这两个案件联系起来之后，我们第一时间封锁了现场，并且对小巷里遗留的痕迹做了详细的侦查。”“目前得出的结论是，在进入这个巷子之前，卢克.邓肯从各个方面来看都是个普通人。”“甚至因为感情婚姻还有经济方面的问题，他有很大的可能轻生。”“但在被黑帮挟持进巷子里，并且身受重伤之后，原本是普通人的他身体突然发生了某种奇妙的变化，又或者说，变异！！！”当着在座各位长官的面，乔治.詹特利说出了自己的猜测。言外之意卢克.邓肯在视频中表现出的非人体质和能力，有可能具备一定几率的复制性。而这......也正是在座各位‘大人物’深夜齐聚NYPD总部，最想听到的消息。在面露喜色低声讨论了一会之后，白宫幕僚长威廉.戴利当场拍板，将有关于卢克.邓肯的事情列为国家最高机密。一旦泄密，以危害国家安全罪论处。同时抽调纽约警察局还有联邦调查局的精锐，临时成立特别调查组，由乔治.詹特利担任组长，用最快速度追踪找到卢克.邓肯的下落。至于被卢克.邓肯杀死的那些人，一点都不重要。无论那几名死者是黑帮，警察，还是无辜者......都不过是一串统计数字而已。最重要的是卢克.邓肯，是他身上展现出的超凡能力！！！......纽约曼哈顿区，丽思卡尔顿酒店的一间总统套房里。利用比翼鸟的天赋能力，轻松换了个身份入住这里的陆白，正一边端着红酒杯欣赏纽约灯火辉煌的夜景，一边查看白泽精怪图中愿力的增长。如果把穿越山海经世界一次所需要的愿力，设定为1的话。他这次的突发奇想为他带来了差不多一千的愿力值。差不多是他最开始看到的，白泽精怪图中积蓄的愿力值的三倍。这说明他的思路没错。想要增加白泽精怪图中的愿力值，需要一些特殊的小技巧。比如说搞事，搞事，还是特么的搞事。“不过貌似现在白泽精怪图内的愿力值增长速度正在放缓，是因为官方开始封锁消息了吗？”陆白摸着下巴，分析着愿力值增速放缓的原因，同时，他将一部分注意力放在了倒霉蛋卢克.邓肯的身上。在赋予了卢克.邓肯一部分金刚的天赋能力之后，陆白就发现，自己能以上帝视角观察被赋予者的存在。同时，赋予能力给他人并不影响他本身的使用，他也可以随时收回那些赋予出去的能力。这有点像是他曾经看过的动漫《死神》里面，大反派友哈巴赫的感觉。唯一不同的是，他并不需要被赋予者喝下带有自己血液的血酒，远程操控即可。“这样一想的话，我岂不是比友哈巴赫还变态......”
content_en:
Two hours later. It's 4:30 a.m. New York time. In a special conference room at the NYPD headquarters at 1 Police Plaza in Lower Manhattan. Sitting in the small room were officials with intimidating positions, including the White House Chief of Staff, the Mayor of New York City, and the Commissioner of the New York Police Department. The atmosphere was eerily solemn. "Huh..." George Gentry, who is usually considered a figure, has the lowest position in this conference room. If this case did not happen to be within his jurisdiction, he would not even be qualified to appear here now. "This is the surveillance footage we retrieved from the Brooklyn Heights property." "It can be seen from the video that Luke Duncan's speed, strength, and defense are far beyond the scope of ordinary humans..." George Gentry inserted the disposable U disk into the device that was physically disconnected from the Internet. The U disk will be destroyed after being pulled out, and then it will be physically smashed. All devices and mobile phones in this room will not be able to connect to the outside world. On the conference room screen, the projector projected the image. Although there was no sound, it did not affect the overall viewing. In the picture, a middle-aged man who looked a little thin but now showed terrifying power that was completely inhuman. With just a slight touch, he knocked out a big hole in the reinforced concrete wall. Then when two New York police officers arrived, those bullets were unable to penetrate his seemingly thin layer of skin. This kind of scene, which had only been seen in Hollywood movies, made everyone present unable to take their eyes away, and their heartbeats involuntarily accelerated. White House Chief of Staff William Daley, who is sixty-one years old and has become the second most powerful person in Washington, turned to look at George Gentry. There was still some disbelief in his blue eyes, or, in other words, the instinctive suspicion of a politician. His voice was a little low and authentic: "Chief George, I want to know if there is any other evidence that I can bring back to the White House besides this video?" "Of course." After a while of adapting, George Gentry has returned to his usual shrewd and capable appearance. He played the second video without any fuss. What appears in the picture this time is a dimly lit alley. The usually dirty gray concrete floor of the alley has been replaced by another color. The dazzling red caught the eyes of everyone present. In addition, there are colorful internal organs and intestines flowing slowly on the ground and corpses broken into two parts. Most people in the conference room frowned in discomfort when they saw this. George Gentry explained in a timely manner: "The murder in the video occurred in an alley on the side of 36th Street in Brooklyn." "Based on the clues we have so far and the testimony of witnesses, we can basically judge that this is the place where Luke Duncan committed his first murder." "The time was about 1:37 a.m. New York time." "At that time. He had just come out of a nearby fast food restaurant and was dragged into an alley by a few black gangsters on his way to New York City. Before that, Luke Duncan didn't show anything special. He was even stabbed a few times by one of the black gangsters..." "So, what do you mean, Chief George?" Everyone here is not a human being. Everyone's eyes lit up when they heard this.

"After receiving the report and linking the two cases, we immediately sealed off the scene and conducted a detailed investigation of the traces left in the alley." "The current conclusion is that before entering this alley, Luke Duncan was an ordinary person in all aspects." "Even because of emotional marriage. There are also financial problems, and he is very likely to commit suicide. "But after being kidnapped into an alley and seriously injured, his body, which was originally an ordinary person, suddenly underwent some kind of strange change, or a mutation! ! !" George Gentley expressed his guess in front of all the officers present. The implication is that Luke Duncan's inhuman physique and abilities shown in the video may have a certain probability of being replicated. And this... is exactly the news that all the 'big shots' here gathered at the NYPD headquarters late at night wanted to hear. After discussing in a low voice with a happy face for a while, White House Chief of Staff William Daley made the decision on the spot to classify the matter about Luke Duncan as a top national secret. Once the secret is leaked, it will be punished as a crime of endangering national security. At the same time, elite members from the New York Police Department and the FBI were mobilized to temporarily set up a special investigation team, with George Gentry as the team leader, to track down Luke Duncan's whereabouts as quickly as possible. As for those people killed by Luke Duncan, it doesn't matter at all. Regardless of whether the dead are gangsters, policemen, or innocent people... they are just a series of statistics. The most important thing is Luke Duncan, it is the extraordinary ability he shows! ! ! ...In a presidential suite at the Ritz-Carlton Hotel in Manhattan, New York. Lu Bai, who had used Biyi Bird's talent to easily change his identity and move in here, was admiring the brightly lit night view of New York with a red wine glass while checking the growth of his will power in the Bai Ze spirit picture. If the willingness required to travel through the world of the Classic of Mountains and Seas once is set to 1. His sudden thought this time brought him almost a thousand wish points. It was almost three times the amount of wish power he had accumulated in the Bai Ze Jinggui picture he first saw. This shows that his thinking is correct. If you want to increase the wish value in the Baize Spirit Picture, you need some special skills. For example, make trouble, make trouble, or really make trouble. "But it seems that the growth rate of the Wish Power value in the Bai Ze Spirit Monster Map is slowing down now. Is it because the official has started to block the news?" Lu Bai touched his chin and analyzed the reasons for the slowdown in the Wish Power Value growth rate. At the same time, he focused part of his attention on the unlucky Luke Duncan. After giving Luke Duncan part of King Kong's innate abilities, Lu Bai discovered that he could observe the existence of the given person from a God's perspective. At the same time, granting abilities to others does not affect his own use, and he can also take back the assigned abilities at any time. This is a bit like the villain Friend Habach in the anime "Bleach" he once watched. The only difference is that he does not need the recipient to drink the blood wine with his own blood, it can be controlled remotely. "If you think about it this way, wouldn't I be more perverted than Yhwach..."
